final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---- bias: reference sink and NMOS current-source mirrors ----
MB0  ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=4  L=1
M5   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=4  L=1 m=8
M8   vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=4  L=1 m=24
* ---- first stage: NMOS diff pair (large area, low 1/f), PMOS mirror load ----
M1   n1    vinn  tail vss nfet W=50 L=2 m=16
M2   out1  vinp  tail vss nfet W=50 L=2 m=16
M3   n1    n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=20 L=2
M4   out1  n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=20 L=2
* ---- second stage: PMOS common source ----
M7   vout  out1  vdd  vdd pfet W=20 L=1 m=8
* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistor (LHP zero near crossover) ----
Rz   out1  nc    1.5k
Cc   nc    vout  7p
.ends
